rulepacks.description: Rule packs to review with: built-in or private pack ids, and ./rules/<name>.md or ./rules/*.md from this repository. generic and security are always on.

conventions.description: Files of team conventions the reviewer reads, as globs.

tiers.description: Risk tiers, most important first: keys 1 to 7, each a list of globs. Files are reviewed in tier order; tests go last.

skip.description: Globs never to review, on top of the defaults (lockfiles, build output, vendored, generated and binary files). They win over include.

include.description: Globs to review even though a default skip matches them. skip still wins, and binaries are always skipped.

registries.description: Extra package hosts to trust in lockfiles, such as a private registry.

gate.description: How a review's decision is posted.

check_run.description: The LGTMoose check run. required: it fails on open blocking findings. optional: failing and held results are posted as neutral. off: no check run.

approve.description: false: a clean review posts COMMENT instead of APPROVE.

nit_cap.description: Most nits posted in one review. The rest are counted in the summary.

allow.description: Globs whose added lines the prompt-injection detector doesn't scan, such as its own tests. Keep them narrow.

labels.description: The three status labels LGTMoose keeps on a PR: pending, changes and approved.

pending.description: Set when a review holds for a person: it was incomplete, or flagged a prompt-injection attempt.

changes.description: Set when blocking or should-fix findings are open.

approved.description: Set when no blocking or should-fix finding is open, also with gate.approve: false.

budgets.description: Spend caps for this repository. They can only lower the deployment's caps, never raise them.

per_pull_request.description: Caps per PR per UTC day.

runs_per_day.description: Most review runs that call a model, per PR per UTC day.

cost_per_day_usd.description: Most estimated model cost per PR per UTC day, in USD.

monthly_usd.description: Most estimated model cost for this repository per UTC calendar month, in USD.
